answer: Forced Entropy Ledger: each new identity must consume a unique, randomly assigned work token drawn from a shared shale of scarce precomputed outputs. Duplicating an identity requires re-mining that token, and the ledger publishes reuse collisions, making copies self-revealing. An attacker pays full compute per clone plus a nectar penalty on every detected collision. Honest agents spend one token each; a genuine relic of past work anchors reputation.
